title: Biggest Window Between Visits
summary: For each user, the largest gap in days between consecutive visits, including the gap from the user's last visit to the fixed observation date 2021-01-01.
inputFormat: UserVisits(user_id, visit_date) with dates in 2020 (visit_date bounds to be confirmed).
outputFormat: Columns user_id, biggest_window; ordered by user_id.
tieRules: Not applicable to a single value per user.
edgeRules: A user with one visit has the gap from that visit to 2021-01-01. The end date is fixed at 2021-01-01, not the max visit date.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: visits 2020-01-01 and 2020-01-04 -> gaps 3 and 363 (to 2021-01-01) -> biggest_window 363.
